The Fourth Sea is confirmed for December 2026 and will be the largest content drop in Blox Fruits history, comparable to when Third Sea added 1,000+ levels and dozens of new systems. Developer confirmation: Uzoth posted: “Of course, if we’re going to do a big update, it’s always going to be at the end of the year. And Sea 4 is for sure by far going to be the biggest update.” A community poll showed 75% of players want Fourth Sea as the top priority for 2026.

Why December?: Blox Fruits always releases major updates during winter break when player count peaks. Update 17 (Third Sea) was the previous record holder for biggest update - Fourth Sea will surpass it. Holiday season means more players online to experience new content and spend Robux on game passes. Beyond the major updates, several smaller features and reworks are confirmed for 2026.

items.question: When is the Blox Fruits Summer Update coming out?
items.answer: Blox Bulletin #024, published July 31, 2026, states the update "will arrive within the next week" — pointing to an early-August 2026 release. No exact date has been given, and Blox Fruits updates have historically slipped a few days past their stated windows, so treat early August as a window, not a guarantee.

items.question: What is confirmed to be in the Summer Update?
items.answer: Officially confirmed by the developers: a full First Sea rebuild (rebuilt locations, altered enemy behavior, expanded stories, new activities), a new Magnet-type Blox Fruit that begins a wave of new fruits, a weapon skin system debuting with the "Rabid" Dog Sword skin, the new Dog Sword and Dog Blade weapons, a new navigation map system, and the largest PvP balance patch in the game's history (including changes to Ghost's summoned allies and Pain's Last Stand ability).

items.question: Is the Venom rework in this update?

items.question: Should I buy fruits now before the update?
items.answer: Be cautious. A "largest ever" PvP patch will reshuffle which fruits are strong, and prices for expected winners are usually already inflated with pre-patch hype. The safer play is to hold your currency, wait for the real balance numbers, and trade into fruits that genuinely came out ahead after launch.
